gloss: leisure time; spare time; free time

definitions.gloss: leisure time; spare time; free time
definitions.explanation: Time free from work or obligations, available for rest and recreation. A somewhat formal word compared to {暇|ひま} or {自由時間|じゆうじかん}.

examples.japanese: {余暇|よか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
{余暇|よか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{過|す}ごしている→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spend my free time reading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{忙|いそが}しすぎて{余暇|よか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I'm so busy with work that I barely have any leisure time.

notes:
USAGE:
{余暇|よか} is a somewhat formal or literary word for free time. It is commonly used in discussions of work-life balance, lifestyle, and recreation. In casual conversation, ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧ or ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {余暇|よか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (to spend leisure time)
- {余暇|よか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (to enjoy leisure time)
- {余暇|よか}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (leisure activities)
- {余暇|よか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧ (how to spend free time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧ — free time (casual, everyday)
- {余暇|よか} — leisure time (formal, often in writing)
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ — free time (neutral, descriptive)
